messages:
marta (People Ops): Quick FYI Priya S. (food demo) is dropping off a small countertop popcorn machine + one sealed swag tote tomorrow at ~9:45 and visiting at 10:30. Can someone meet the courier, grab a dolly, and print a guest sticker? Also: she asked for a mini table near the kitchen and a fridge spot for one cooler. Please tag the tote as 'promo' and note allergen-free (no nuts).

sam: I can cover 9:3010:00 at the desk and bring a folding dolly. Will not leave machine in the main hallway. :popcorn:

jorge: I'll print a badge "Guest: Food Demo - Priya S." + Wi-Fi card. Mini table and fridge spot reserved. Anyone want popcorn? :yum:

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registration found: Priya S. ID uploaded, vehicle plate GHT-882. Courier ETA 9:40. Add delivery to https://redwood-internal/deliveries.

mailroom: If the tote contains breakables, tag FRAGILE and place on hospitality shelf or Locker B1. We'll mark promo items in the spreadsheet.

facilities: Dolly and straps at lobby by 9:15. We'll leave a small mat under the popcorn machine and a sign that says "Allergen-free: No nuts".

visitor: Priya S.: Hey all I'll aim for 9:50 with the machine in a single box and one sealed tote. Thanks for the fridge space and "no nuts" sign! Looking forward to 10:30.

sam: Got it. I'll move the box to B1 after check-in and tag it promo+fragile. Jorge popcorn for the team sounds great, but let's keep it in the kitchen area and not the desks.

marta (People Ops): Awesome team thanks. Reminder: log delivery condition in the sheet and ping me if the courier leaves unsigned. Also please don't prop boxes in the stairwell. :heart:
